features.text: Picks the user's language in the language menu
Goal vocabulary in English and Hindi (wrong charge = dispute = शिकायत)
Presses keys or speaks as the menu expects; switches when a menu ignores keys
Waits for a prompt (and any disclaimer) to finish before acting
Types IDs as digits only (OD123 -> 123) after a rejected entry
Remembers menu paths that worked on earlier calls
Escapes loops and dead ends via the executive option
Knows what hold recordings say ('your call is important')
Anything heard twice on hold is a recording
Background room sound points to a live person
Synthetic/studio voice points to a recording
When unsure, says 'hello?': a person replies, a recording doesn't
Asks the executive to wait while the user is connected
Reads announced wait/position and warns the user early
Shows the user the menu as text
Asks the user for the OTP in the app and reads it out
Asks for reference numbers and facts twice and checks they match
Refuses retention offers the user didn't want
Pushes for a discount up to the user's target
If the executive won't talk to an AI, connects the user
Dials the toll-free number when the user gives an operator short code
Calls back after 'all executives busy' or a dropped call
Takes the helpline's callback offer when asked to
Never types a PIN: the user keys it in themselves
Recognises the bank's own voicebot and asks for a human or a fast exchange
